presets.label: Generic HMAC
presets.description: Verify a signed raw request body with HMAC SHA-256 and route accepted deliveries into a workspace thread plus linked task.

editor.scopeSummary: This slice records every verified delivery and routes accepted events into the existing thread and task workflow without provider-specific normalization.
editor.operatorFocus: The main page should stay focused on endpoint health and delivery inspection. Open the editor only when you need to create or adjust an ingress profile.

presets.label: GitHub
presets.description: Verify GitHub webhook signatures, record immutable delivery rows, and route failed completed workflow runs into a workspace thread plus linked task.

editor.scopeSummary: This slice records every signed delivery, normalizes workflow_run, and routes only failed completed runs.
editor.operatorFocus: The main page should stay focused on endpoint health and delivery inspection. Open the editor only when you need to create or adjust an ingress profile.

allowedSourcePaths.label: Allowed repositories
allowedSourcePaths.helpText: One owner/repo per line. Leave blank to allow failed workflow runs from any repository that uses this secret.

presets.label: GitLab
presets.description: Verify GitLab webhook secret tokens, record immutable delivery rows, and route failed pipeline hooks into a workspace thread plus linked task.

editor.scopeSummary: This slice records every verified delivery, normalizes Pipeline Hook, and routes only failed pipelines.
editor.operatorFocus: The main page should stay focused on endpoint health and delivery inspection. Open the editor only when you need to create or adjust an ingress profile.
editor.secretPlaceholder: Paste the GitLab shared secret token

allowedSourcePaths.label: Allowed projects
allowedSourcePaths.helpText: One group/project per line. Leave blank to allow failed pipelines from any project that uses this token.
